newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine consumer inflation down 0.3 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Argentine consumer inflation down 0.3 pct in April.

text.p: Argentine consumer prices fell 0.3 percent in April after being flat in April 1996, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
Wholesale prices fell 0.4 percent in April compared with a rise of 1.5 percent in the same month in 1996.
The decline in April took 12-month consumer price inflation to 0.6 percent compared with 1.0 percent in March.
Yearly wholesale price inflation showed a decline of 0.8 percent.
April's decline of 0.3 percent in consumer prices was below average forecasts. Analysts had predicted a 0.1 percent rise.
